description_en: Queries the knowledge base directory content visible to the current OpenAPI user
description_zh: 查询当前 OpenAPI 用户可见知识库目录内容
name: ListUserVisibleKnowledgeBaseContents

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. This is a common parameter. Pass it explicitly through --tenant-id in winnexo-cli
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，公共参数；winnexo-cli 通过 --tenant-id 显式传入
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en:
The field by which the results are sorted. Valid values:

event_time: the event creation time.
event_execute_start_time: the event execution time.
event_execute_finish_time: the event completion time
parameters.help_zh:
返回结果按照哪个字段排序，可选值如下：

event_time：事件创建时间
event_execute_start_time：事件执行时间
event_execute_finish_time：事件完成时间
parameters.name: sort_field

parameters.help_en: The sort order. This parameter takes effect when sortBy is specified. Valid values: ASC, DESC (case-insensitive)
parameters.help_zh: 指定排序顺序，sortBy填写时生效。可填值：ASC,DESC(大小写不敏感)
parameters.name: sort_order

parameters.help_en: The list of service source types
parameters.name: source_types

parameters.help_en: The search keyword. Supports fuzzy match on version names
parameters.help_zh: 搜索关键词，支持对版本名称的模糊搜索
parameters.name: keyword
